wins.text: Q1 revenue of $12.7B, up 9% YoY, finishing in line with guidance; EPS of $0.18 beat guidance by $0.05 on operating spending discipline and strong sell-through of previously reserved inventory
Intel Products revenue of $11.9B, up 17% YoY; client business grew more than 30% YoY; operating margin of approximately 28%, with operating profit expanding by more than $2.1B YoY
Gross margin of 45.1% came in 60 basis points above guidance despite peak 5-nodes-in-4-years start-up costs

Announced Microsoft as fifth Intel 18A customer; signed a sixth customer (aerospace & defense leader) in Q1; pipeline of nearly 50 test chips; advanced packaging engagements with nearly every foundry customer including 5 design awards
Gaudi 3 launched at Intel Vision 2024 with 20+ customers publicly endorsing Gaudi 2/3; management now expects over $500M in accelerated computing revenue in H2 2024 with increasing momentum into 2025

risks.text: Intel Foundry operating loss deepened; foundry revenue of $4.4B down 10% YoY; operating margins expected to trough in 2024 as start-up costs peak and ~$2B incremental depreciation hits the P&L
Q2 gross margin guided to approximately 43.5%, a sequential decline despite higher revenue, driven by rising factory start-up costs and pull-forward of Q1 inventory sell-through benefits
First-half demand signals described as 'modestly weaker than originally anticipated'; Q2 client revenue constrained by wafer-level assembly supply shortages limiting Core Ultra AI PC shipments

Mobileye revenue of $239M and operating loss of $68M both down meaningfully YoY due to iQ customer inventory drawdown; Altera revenue of $342M down significantly YoY with a $39M operating loss from industry-wide inventory digestion

Server CPU market share under pressure; management acknowledged it 'takes time' for new products (Sierra Forest, Granite Rapids) to ramp and stabilize share, with meaningful gains not expected until end of 2024 and into 2025

guidance_items.detail: Q2 revenue guided to $12.5B–$13.5B (midpoint $13B); full-year revenue growth reaffirmed with acceleration in H2
Q2 non-GAAP EPS guided to $0.10; full-year EPS growth reaffirmed
Q2 non-GAAP gross margin guided to ~43.5%, down from Q1's 45.1%; full-year gross margin expected ~200 bps above FY23, implying ~45.5% for FY24
Net capital intensity forecast of mid-30s as % of revenue across 2023–2024 in aggregate unchanged; ~neutral 2024 adjusted free cash flow still expected
Altera expected to exit 2024 at $2B revenue run rate; Gaudi/accelerator revenue expected to exceed $500M in H2 2024; Mobileye reiterated full-year guidance

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Whether the H2 revenue recovery is market-driven vs. Intel-specific share gains in server CPUs, given how long new product ramps take to impact share
The risk that gen AI server build-outs (dominated by GPU accelerators and ARM-based CPUs) could structurally shrink the x86 server CPU TAM over time
Flexibility and timeline for pulling back externally manufactured compute tiles to internal Intel Foundry nodes as a proof point for 18A yield and economics
